name: Toyo Tires
verdict: Toyo Tire Corporation, a Tokyo-listed Japanese tyre maker. Nothing found.
note: Left-sleeve sponsor of Gamba Osaka 2026-27 per the club's uniform launch page. Rating note: largest holder is Mitsubishi Corporation (20.01% as of 2026-06-30; it ceased to qualify as a major shareholder on 2026-08-10 per the company), then trust banks; no state stake. Mitsubishi Corporation is itself a listed Japanese company with institutional ownership. No human-rights finding against Toyo Tire was found.
